Have you ever wondered why you are not the one who bumped into some really obvious idea to run a business? Or even if you were thinking to start something, why you weren’t brave enough to take a risk? Many people is afraid of new ideas, new paths in live mostly only because they are afraid to fail. In this article you will find advices how to create unusual business. Moreover – we reveal a secret how to make it profitable!

I. Believe in yourself Even if it sounds trivial, that’s the base rule. Thousands of people don’t believe in success and that is why they don’t even start to set their idea into real life. Think – how many times in your life did you resign from action (flirting with girl in pub, play in poker, invest on stock) only because you weren’t perky enough? Believe in your strength, intelligence and creativity is the first step to run business. Limit from your dictionary words like „I can’t / no / impossible / cannot work” – they block your brain and bravery. Instead, when whenever you will have problems, try to think in „maybe” way – try to try!

II find a hole – maybe implement business from different country? Okay, now we have to be more pragmatic. If you already have an idea what kind of business you would like to run, make market research. Check if in your area you will be pioneer. If not – how strong your competitors are? Who is the target? On what are they focused the most? When you know your rivals they can become your partners or enemies – from you and your tactic depends which scenario will come true. What if you are the person who is just thinking about being independent and self-employed, but you still have no idea what can you do? There is just one rule: observe the world. Do it really carefully, make market research, compare your market with similar ones all around the world. Trends, which are famous there, can be also perfect to your market in few months! Take a risk and remember, that any idea is stupid or impossible idea – My life was full of different adventures. I was travelling all around the world, I left my country and moved to another one without any plan. What did I do then? I decided to become the King and I made my dream to come true. – says Mariusz Bialek, owner of one of the really interesting and unique businesses. – I weren’t able to invest a lot of money in my own business, so I was looking for something cheap and creative. After small research I decided to use old Romanian rule of law and announce, that the whole Universe is mine. In that way I created my Kingdom of Universe and now I am selling stars, planets and dark matter. That example shows, that borders don’t exist anywhere apart of your mind – so be open, forget about impossible and explore the world to find your place to run a business!

III ask yourself few questions: what I want to reach? Who will be my customer? Do I have a plan? How big risk can I take? Make a list of questions, needs, possibilities, risks, create your general business plan with schedule. That will help you to give a fresh look on your idea. Pros and cons, SWOT analyze, or even short, quick survey (made online or just ask your friends or family) will show you what more you have to do and sort it by priority.

IV Create unusual, original visual identity Let’s say that you finally decide to run your own business. Apart of money, business plan, idea and your passion you have to become visible to your future clients. Logo, slogan, adverts, website, social media channels, media relations and whole visual identity is must-have. In addition remember to be odd-one-out, unique, original – the more unconventional you are, the bigger probability that people will notice and remember you. Don’t be afraid to ask advertisement or PR agency for help. Be honest – you don’t cut hair on your own, don’t use home-made solarium and don’t repair serious damages in your car on your own. If you ask for help specialists in these areas, so you should be open for PR specialist as well.

V Do what you like and have fun! So, this is it! Now you have your passion, self-confidence, perfect idea, business plan, whole SWOT analyze. Your business is well known and everyone can recognize your logo, brand name and whole visual identity. Now is the time to relax. Remember, that your own business should bring you joy and happiness!

I've been reading a lot about the business model canvas and it looks like a very interesting way to test a number of business models and ensure you've really thought about 9 aspects that can drive business success.

The notion is that unlike a business plan, this is a living document that you test and change until you settle on the best model. A short description of each of the elements of the business model canvass:

Customer Segments: Who are the customers? What do they think? See? Feel? Do? Value Propositions: What’s compelling about the proposition? Why do customers buy, use? Channels: How are these propositions promoted, sold and delivered? Why? Is it working? Customer Relationships: How do you interact with the customer through their ‘journey’? Revenue Streams: How does the business earn revenue from the value propositions? Key Activities: What uniquely strategic things does the business do to deliver its proposition? Key Resources: What unique strategic assets must the business have to compete? Key Partnerships: What can the company not do so it can focus on its Key Activities? Cost Structure: What are the business’ major cost drivers? How are they linked to revenue?
